title: Nerdy Splash Texts
description: Adds Splash text for Nerds which update every time with a funny nerdy joke.
body:
# Nerdy Splash Texts

Want your Minecraft to get a little nerdier? No?
Well doesn't matter cause I already made a pack for it
This pack doesn’t mess with your items or gameplay—it just swaps out the splash texts for nerdy ones. Open the game and get nerdy splash text every time!

Works with vanilla Minecraft, super easy

No gameplay changes.
